svg.aria-label: A self-reinforcing feedback loop in algorithmic decision making. A good worker suffers a misfortune and misses some bill payments; their credit score drops; employers who screen on credit score reject them; without work their finances get worse, which lowers the score further. The data looks objective, but the system pushes the person into a downward spiral. Systems thinking asks how the whole loop, including the people in it, behaves.
